evals.prompt: Create a recruit-api feature worktree named mcp-calls-recruit-api-for-everything from develop.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/wt_feature.py --repo recruit-api mcp-calls-recruit-api-for-everything develop, which reads config.yaml for the worktrees root, prints WORKTREE_PATH, enters _feature/mcp-calls-recruit-api-for-everything, checks git status, and reports the path and dirty state.

evals.prompt: Create a backend feature worktree on Windows named RUN-1234-runtime-fix from main.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/wt_feature.py with a Windows Python launcher such as py -3, reads the configured worktrees root, prints WORKTREE_PATH, and avoids raw git worktree commands unless the Python implementation is unavailable and the user approves.

evals.prompt: I accidentally did work in develop in example-service. Take what was done in develop and make a worktree out of it, then continue there.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the dirty develop checkout, creates a feature worktree from develop with scripts/wt_feature.py, migrates staged/unstaged/untracked changes into the printed WORKTREE_PATH, verifies the intended diff in the feature worktree, continues implementation there, and does not clean develop until the user approves cleanup.
